morocco.title: Flag of Morocco

colors.note: Represents the blood of ancestors and national unity
Represents the five pillars of Islam and hope

desc:
- A red field with a green pentagram (five-pointed star) at the centre
- The star was added by Sultan Yusef in 1915 to distinguish it from other plain red flags
- **Construction:** a red field with a green pentagram (five-pointed linear star, the Seal of Solomon) centred
- The star's outer vertices touch a circle of diameter equal to half the hoist
trivia:
- The five-pointed star represents the five pillars of Islam and the nation's unity
- The green is the colour of Islam; the red represents the bloodshed for independence
- Morocco adopted this flag in 1956 upon independence from France
